description: This file declares the interface class ISessionServerManager for managing session server operations in the Rialto media server component. It includes method declarations for initialization, configuration, state management, logging, and ping functionality, and references external classes and types such as IAckSender, SessionServerCommon, and common::SessionServerState.

classes.name: ISessionServerManager
classes.description: An interface class defining the contract for session server management, including lifecycle, configuration, logging, and health check methods.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the session server manager with command-line arguments.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Configures the session server with socket name, state, resource limits, display name, and permissions.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the current state of the session server.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Sets various log levels for different components.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Performs a health check or keep-alive ping, using an acknowledgment sender.
